title: Odd Lots: The Story of Europe’s Decline Isn’t So Simple
description: On this episode of the Odd Lots podcast, economist Dominik Leusder tells Joe Weisenthal and Tracy Alloway why he thinks the Draghi report might have mismeasured the true scale of Europe's decline and whether the popular narrative of European decline is an accurate one.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Samsung Profit Up Almost Nine-Fold With Memory Chip Windfall
description: Samsung Electronics Co. reported a nearly nine-fold rise in quarterly operating profit, though that was still just shy of sky-high expectations elevated by relentless spending on the AI infrastructure buildout.

title: Nvidia-Backed Firmus Said to Close Books as Mega IPO Struggles
description: Australian data center company Firmus Grid Ltd. has closed the books on its struggling initial public offering as investors grew increasingly concerned that the deal could be pulled, according to people familiar with the information.
